_comment: The arXiv category list the ideas bot mines. This file is the one real
judgement call in the pipeline, which is why it is config and not code.
Each group names the surface family it feeds (spec/curated.js familyOrder).
Tune for RECALL, not precision: the gate and the concept agent reject
cheaply, and the surprises come from breadth. On 2026-07-29, four of five
good concepts came from two categories -- but the fifth came from cs.CR,
where 27 of 28 papers were irrelevant. Narrowing would have been faster
maxPerCategory bounds one day's fetch. Large categories (math.CO, cs.CR)
hit it; q-bio.* mostly does not.

groups.why: Bio modelling -- the whole q-bio tree. Feeds splice, labglass, j, phylofiction. Requested addition 2026-07-29: the first pass sampled only PE and QM and returned six papers, which is why no bio concept made the cut.
Extremal geometry and combinatorics -- the math wing's explainers (erdos, kakeya, capset, heilbronn, szemeredi-trotter, viazovska).
Habitat modelling: structure, thermodynamics, crowds, orbital mechanics. Feeds hoop, rind, tide, iris, biome, mega.
Seeded generators, open-ended evolution, agent ecologies. Feeds fluoddity, reef, civ, polis, fable, phylofiction.
Network structure, graph communities, collective behaviour. Feeds feed, zoom, b, empathy, polis.
Anything with a win condition, a strategy, or an adversary -- the games wing plus human's bias arcade.
